keyword.zh: 电动30和柴油30是不是同一台泵

title.zh: 电动30和柴油30混凝土泵是同一台吗

description.en: The shared number 30 is not a shared machine. One row is a 30 kW motor. The other is a 4105 diesel at 56 kW.
description.zh: 名称里的 30 不是同一台机器。一行是 30 kW 电机，另一行是 4105 柴油机 56 kW。

h1.zh: 电动30和柴油30混凝土泵是同一台吗

directAnswer.en: Electric 30 and Diesel 30 are different concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 30 prints a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h and two stone-distance rows. Diesel 30 prints engine 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, outlet pressure 20 MPa and one distance pair, 60 m / 180 m. The catalogue does not treat the numeral 30 as theoretical output.
directAnswer.zh: 电动30和柴油30是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台不同混凝土泵。电动30印 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h 和两行石子距离。柴油30印发动机 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、出口压力 20 MPa，以及一组距离 60 m / 180 m。目录没有把数字 30 当成理论输送量。

heading.en: Where Electric 30 and Diesel 30 print different values
heading.zh: 电动30和柴油30哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h; Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Max. aggregate size: Electric 30 prints ≤ 3 cm; Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below. Dimensions: Electric 30 prints 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm; Diesel 30 prints 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Main unit weight: Electric 30 prints 1200 kg; Diesel 30 prints 2000 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 20 MPa on both pages; Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³ on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动30印 12–15 m³/h；柴油30印 15 m³/h。最大骨料粒径：电动30印 ≤ 3 cm；柴油30印 3 cm and below。外形尺寸：电动30印 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm；柴油30印 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。整机重量：电动30印 1200 kg；柴油30印 2000 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 20 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.3 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 30 prints cells that Diesel 30 does not: Motor power 30 kW; Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 20 m / 60 m. Diesel 30 prints cells that Electric 30 does not: Diesel engine power 4105 / 56 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动30有、柴油30没有的行：电机功率 30 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 20 m / 60 m。柴油30有、电动30没有的行：柴油机功率 4105 / 56 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Match the power line first: motor kilowatts on one page, an engine code on the other. Open /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ for Electric 30 and /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 先看动力行：一页是电机千瓦，另一页是发动机代号。看电动30请打开 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/，看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 30 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动30和柴油30的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30印 12–15 m³/h。柴油30印 15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 30 print the same max. aggregate size as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动30和柴油30的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 prints ≤ 3 cm. Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30印 ≤ 3 cm。柴油30印 3 cm and below。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 30 print the same dimensions as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 电动30和柴油30的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 prints 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Diesel 30 prints 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动30印 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。柴油30印 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 30?
question.zh: 为什么柴油30没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 30 page does not print that label. Electric 30 prints 30 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油30这一页没有印这个标题。电动30印的是 30 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
